Name: ToolSense - Big Update
Author: HoangTuDaa18
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55292/55292-1795527261-1722016645.png[/img][/center]
Coming from the mobile version of Stardew Valley, moving to PC made me realize something I'd never thought twice about before: just how much time goes into manually swapping tools. Chopping wood, mining rocks, watering crops—constantly switching hotbar slots quickly became a tiny, repetitive speed bump in an otherwise relaxing game.
That minor friction is what sparked [color=#93c47d][b]ToolSense.[/b][/color]
[color=#93c47d][b]ToolSense[/b][/color] makes interacting with the world feel second nature. It recognizes your target, pulls the right tool from your inventory on the fly, and restores your previous slot the moment you finish. Alongside smart tool selection, it brings habit learning, combat support, customizable targeting modes, and automatic furnace prep—everything you need for a smoother, more intuitive farming experience.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55292/55292-1795510601-1436356639.gif[/img]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55292/55292-1795527467-797082192.png[/img][/center]
[heading][quote][b][color=#00ffff]1. Intelligent Automatic Tool Selection 🧠[/color][/b][/quote][/heading]
[spoiler][b][color=#00ffff]ToolSense[/color][/b] automatically recognizes supported targets and selects the most suitable available tool from your entire inventory, so you can focus on playing instead of constantly switching toolbar slots.
[list]
[*][b]🪓 [color=#00ffff]Axe:[/color][/b] Automatically selects an axe for trees, stumps, and other suitable targets.[/*]
[*][b]⛏️ [color=#00ffff]Pickaxe:[/color][/b] Selects a pickaxe for rocks, boulders, resource clumps, and other suitable targets.[/*]
[*][b]🪏 [color=#00ffff]Hoe:[/color][/b] Selects a hoe for artifact spots and designated diggable targets. Optionally, it can also select a hoe when targeting empty, diggable ground.[/*]
[*][b]🚿 [color=#00ffff]Watering Can:[/color][/b] Automatically selects a watering can when targeting dry soil, crops that need watering, and pet bowls.[/*]
[*][b]🌙[color=#00ffff] Scythe:[/color][/b] Selects a scythe for grass, weeds, and suitable crops.[/*]
[*][b]🥛 [color=#00ffff]Milk Pail:[/color][/b] Automatically selects a Milk Pail when interacting with animals that are ready to be milked.[/*]
[*][b]✂️ [color=#00ffff]Shears:[/color][/b] Automatically selects Shears when interacting with sheep that are ready to be sheared.[/*]
[*][b]💧 [color=#00ffff]Water Management:[/color][/b] Automatically selects your watering can when its water level falls below your configured refill threshold.[/*]
[*][b]🎣[color=#00ffff] Fishing Rod:[/color][/b] Automatically selects your fishing rod when targeting water, unless your watering can needs refilling.[/*]
[*][b]🥘[color=#00ffff] Copper Pan:[/color][/b] Automatically selects your pan when targeting shimmering water spots.[/*]
[*][b]🍄 [color=#00ffff]Auto-Forage Pickup:[/color][/b] Automatically collects forageable items as you walk past them.[/*]
[/list][b][color=#00ffff]ToolSense[/color][/b] searches your entire inventory for suitable tools, prioritizes higher-upgrade options, and avoids unnecessary switching between equally suitable tools.
[color=#00ffff][b]Optional protection settings[/b] [/color]help prevent accidental damage to young trees, fruit trees, tapped trees, giant crops, and placed paths or flooring.[/spoiler]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55292/55292-1795510635-1661746194.gif[/img][img width=425]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55292/55292-1795510700-2006015940.gif[/img][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55292/55292-1795755999-1244470867.gif[/img]
[heading][quote][b][color=#e06666]2. Combat Assist & Combat Mode⚔️[/color][/b][/quote][/heading]
[spoiler]Stay ready for combat without constantly managing your toolbar. [b][color=#e06666]ToolSense[/color][/b] helps you equip the right weapon and keep it ready when enemies are nearby.
[list]
[*][b]⚔️ [color=#e06666]Combat Assist:[/color][/b] Automatically selects a suitable melee weapon by estimating how quickly it can defeat your target, considering weapon damage, attack speed, and enemy durability. It also takes nearby enemy groups and area-of-effect (AoE) advantages into account.[/*]
[*][b]🛡️ [color=#e06666]Auto-Equip on Attacked:[/color][/b] Automatically equips a weapon when you are attacked.[/*]
[*][b]🎯 [color=#e06666]Aim Assist:[/color][/b] Helps identify nearby monsters within your configured detection radius and aiming angle.[/*]
[*][b]↗️ [color=#e06666]Lead Targeting:[/color][/b] Accounts for monster movement when determining the best target.[/*]
[*][b]⚔️ [color=#e06666]Combat Mode:[/color][/b] Keeps your weapon equipped while enemies are nearby, preventing unwanted switches to regular tools when targeting grass, soil, or water.[/*]
[*]Customize combat detection range, aim assist radius, aiming angle, lead time, and weapon restoration delay.[/*]
[*]Optionally ignore Slimes inside the Slime Hutch.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55292/55292-1794850196-2049131861.gif[/img]
[heading][quote][b][color=#9900ff]3. Hold to Retarget & Target Stability🎯[/color][/b][/quote][/heading]
[spoiler]Designed for continuous gameplay, these features help [color=#9900ff][b]ToolSense[/b] [/color]respond smoothly as you move between targets.
[list]
[*][b][color=#9900ff]Hold to Retarget:[/color][/b] Continuously checks your target while holding the use-tool button, automatically switching tools as you move between targets.[/*]
[*][b][color=#9900ff]Target Stability:[/color][/b] Prevents unnecessary tool switching when moving your cursor across multiple targets by requiring a new target to remain stable for a configurable number of consecutive checks.[/*]
[*][b][color=#9900ff]Instant Initial Selection:[/color][/b] Your initial tool selection is never delayed by Target Stability.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[heading][quote][b][color=#ff00ff]4. Smart Restore🧠[/color][/b][/quote][/heading]
[spoiler][b][color=#ff00ff]ToolSense[/color][/b] remembers your original toolbar selection before automatically switching tools, then restores it once the action sequence is complete.
It coordinates tool restoration across different activities, including regular tool use, combat, and machine interactions.
[list]
[*]Automatically restores your previous toolbar selection.[/*]
[*]Customize the restoration delay.[/*]
[*]Uses a separate restoration delay after combat.[/*]
[*]Automatically respects manual toolbar changes.[/*]
[*]Disable [b][color=#ff00ff]Smart Restore[/color][/b] entirely if you prefer manual toolbar management.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[heading][quote][b][color=#f6b26b]5. Habit Learning & Modded Object Learning📖[/color][/b][/quote][/heading]
[spoiler]Not every player uses the same tools for the same situations.[b][color=#f6b26b] ToolSense[/color][/b] learns from your repeated manual choices and gradually adapts to your preferences.
[b][color=#f6b26b]Habit Learning (v3)[/color][/b]
[list]
[*]Learns from repeated manual tool overrides after [b][color=#f6b26b]ToolSense[/color][/b] makes a selection.[/*]
[*]Applies learned preferences to the same type of target in future interactions.[/*]
[*]Learns your preferred machine ingredient source, whether from nearby chests or your inventory.[/*]
[*]Remembers your preferred item quality when selecting machine ingredients.[/*]
[*]Customize how many manual overrides are required before a preference is learned.[/*]
[*]Learned habits are saved separately for each save file.[/*]
[*]Forget learned habits whenever you like.[/*]
[/list][b][color=#f6b26b]Modded Object Learning[/color][/b]
[list]
[*]Encountered an object added by another mod that [color=#f6b26b][b]ToolSense[/b][/color] doesn't recognize? Just use your tools manually until you successfully interact with it.[/*]
[*][b][color=#f6b26b]ToolSense[/color][/b] observes successful tool usage and learns which tool works for that object.[/*]
[*]Automatically selects the learned tool the next time you encounter that object.[/*]
[*]Learned object knowledge is shared across all save files.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[quote][b][size=5][color=#ffff00]6. Smart Machine Support [/color][color=#c27ba0]🏭[/color][/size][/b][/quote][spoiler][b][color=#ffff00]ToolSense[/color][/b] makes loading machines easier and smoother by automatically selecting suitable ingredients from your inventory, without manually searching through your items.
[b]Supported Machines[/b]
[list]
[*][b]🥚 [color=#ffff00]Mayonnaise Machine:[/color][/b] Automatically selects suitable eggs.[/*]
[*][b]🧀 [color=#ffff00]Cheese Press:[/color][/b] Automatically selects suitable milk.[/*]
[*][b]🧵 [color=#ffff00]Loom:[/color][/b] Automatically selects suitable wool.[/*]
[*][b]🫒 [color=#ffff00]Oil Maker:[/color][/b] Automatically selects suitable ingredients for oil production.[/*]
[*][b]🐟 [color=#ffff00]Fish Smoker:[/color][/b] Automatically selects suitable fish for smoking.[/*]
[*][b]🔥 [color=#ffff00]Furnace:[/color][/b] Automatically selects suitable ores for smelting.[/*]
[/list][b][color=#ffff00]Quick & Smooth Ingredient Cycling[/color][/b]
[list]
[*][b]🖱️ [color=#ffff00]Mouse Wheel:[/color][/b] Easily cycle through available ingredients by scrolling your mouse wheel.[/*]
[*][b]⌨️ [color=#ffff00]R Key:[/color][/b] Press R to quickly switch to the next available ingredient.[/*]
[*][b]🎯 [color=#ffff00]Smart Target Lock:[/color][/b] Keeps ingredient selection tied to the machine you last clicked, preventing accidental switching between nearby machines.[/*]
[*][b]📦 [color=#ffff00]Smart Inventory & Chest Selection:[/color][/b] Finds suitable ingredients from your inventory and nearby chests, prioritizing your preferences and recent item choices.[/*]
[/list][b][color=#ffff00]Furnace Settings[/color][/b]
[list]
[*]Customize which ore types [b][color=#ffff00]ToolSense[/color][/b] can automatically select, including [color=#ffff00][b]Copper, Iron, Gold, Iridium, Radioactive,[/b][/color] and [color=#ffff00][b]other supported ores.[/b][/color][/*]
[*]Optionally require Coal before selecting ores for the [b][color=#ffff00]Furnace.[/color][/b][/*]
[/list]All machine loading and ingredient consumption are handled through the game's normal interactions.[/spoiler]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55292/55292-1795757265-1805080032.gif[/img]
[quote][b][color=#00ff00][size=5]7. Customization & Controller Support⚙️[/size][/color][/b][/quote][spoiler]Everyone has their own playstyle, and [color=#00ff00][b]ToolSense[/b][/color] is designed to adapt to yours!
Don't like a particular feature? No problem! Most features can be individually enabled, disabled, or adjusted through [color=#00ff00][b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b][/color], allowing you to keep only what you enjoy and tailor the experience to your preferences.
[list]
[*]Customize individual tool selection and gameplay behaviors.[/*]
[*]Adjust target detection, tree protection, combat settings, and restoration delays.[/*]
[*]Configure Machine Support and individual machine options.[/*]
[*]Fine-tune watering can refill thresholds and learning behaviors.[/*]
[*]Toggle [b][color=#00ff00]ToolSense[/color][/b] on or off using a configurable hotkey.[/*]
[*]Optionally display a toolbar status indicator when[color=#00ff00][b] ToolSense[/b][/color] is enabled.[/*]
[*]Supports[color=#00ff00][b] Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b][/color] for convenient in-game configuration (optional dependency).[/*]
[*]Full controller support for toggle hotkeys, including controller buttons and button combinations.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[center][quote][color=#ff00ff][size=5][b]FAQ ^-^[/b][/size][/color][/quote][/center]
[center][spoiler][left][color=#ff00ff][b]Q: Why should I choose ToolSense? What makes your mod stand out? [/b][/color]
That’s a good question. There are plenty of AutoTool mods out there—do some even work better? Yeah, maybe. More features than ToolSense? Okay, easy. But I want to emphasize that ToolSense is designed around being as smart as possible. It doesn’t just pick an axe just because there’s a tree in front of it; it has to be context-aware and go through multiple layers of modules before actually making a final decision. Above all, it’s designed for quality of life—it wants to elevate and improve your experience to the next level. To be honest with you, ToolSense might have fewer features and can't do many things that competitors can, but I stand by this: everything ToolSense does is top-tier and the smartest in its category compared to other AutoTool mods.
[color=#ff00ff][b]Q: Is this mod 100% AI-generated?[/b][/color]
This one’s a little delicate, so I’d rather just be straight with you.
The short answer is: No.
For me, AI is a helper, not a substitute for actually building and caring about a project. All the ideas, design choices, testing, and quality checks come from me. I definitely don't just hand the whole thing over to AI. I’m not the type to type "Hey AI, make me a cool auto-tool mod!" and upload whatever comes out. Honestly, that would be a disaster, haha! At the same time, I’m not going to pretend I wrote every single line by hand either. AI probably helped with around 50–70% of the actual implementation work. I like being upfront about that because I don’t want to lean heavily on AI, act like I did it all myself, and sell people on some grand "amazing experience." That just wouldn't sit right with me. So I hope that makes sense. AI is a tool I use along the way, but the vision, calls, and accountability behind ToolSense are mine.
[b][color=#ff00ff] Q: Can I translate the mod?[/color][/b]
[color=#efefef] Sure thing—I even really welcome it so ToolSense can reach more people. If you want to be credited in the credits, just let me know. However, I recommend uploading translations as just a single JSON file. That’s better because ToolSense updates very frequently, and uploading full DLLs could leave users of your language on an outdated version. [/color]
[color=#ff00ff][b]Q: Why are there so many updates? Why not save everything up for one big release?[/b][/color]
Man, I wish it were that simple! Every update needs proper testing to make sure it fits ToolSense’s standards and design philosophy. Bugs and weird edge cases happen, so I’d rather ship fixes and tweaks steadily than sit on everything until it turns into one giant, messy update. That said, if your current version is working great for you, honestly, just stick with it! If you like checking out new features and polish as they come, the latest version will always have the newest stuff.
[color=#ff00ff][b]Q: How can I help out?[/b][/color]
Just being here already helps! Every download and endorsement genuinely goes a long way in helping ToolSense reach more players. It might seem small, but as a solo mod maker, it means a lot. And if you run into a bug or something feels off, please give me a heads-up! I’d much rather hear about it and try to fix it than have you quietly uninstall and walk away without saying a word. :( Bug reports, feedback, and ideas are always welcome.
[/left]
[/spoiler]
[/center]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55292/55292-1795527747-1384846115.png[/img][/center]
[spoiler][b][color=#93c47d]ToolSense[/color][/b] now gives you full control over how targets are detected, instead of locking you into standard mouse-cursor aiming. Head into [b][color=#93c47d]GMCM → General Settings[/color][/b] to switch between four distinct modes tailored to your playstyle:

[b][color=#3c78d8]True Cursor (Default)[/color][/b]
Preserves 100% of the classic [b][color=#3c78d8]ToolSense[/color][/b] behavior you already know. It strictly targets the exact tile directly beneath your mouse cursor—offering the highest pinpoint accuracy and serving as a reliable, all-around choice for any player.

[img width=317]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55292/55292-1795524605-589978031.gif[/img]
[b]
[color=#00ffff]Cursor Gaze (Author's Pick🌟)[/color][/b]
Whenever you click anywhere on screen, your farmer automatically turns to face that direction right before swinging or using a tool. While it shares the same core logic as [color=#00ffff][b]True Cursor[/b][/color], it removes awkward directional locking and feels noticeably smoother and more responsive—a great upgrade for everyone, especially if you enjoy fluid, natural movement.
[img width=320]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55292/55292-1795524636-1915067928.gif[/img]
[b]
[color=#9900ff]Cursor Sweep[/color][/b]
Expands the detection radius around your cursor instead of checking only a single tile. This trades a bit of pinpoint precision for a wider catch zone, making rapid, repetitive actions on the same type of resource much faster. It shines in places like the Mines or dense tree farms, though it isn't recommended for everyday casual play around delicate crops or decorations.
[img width=324]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55292/55292-1795524692-1275027082.gif[/img]

[b][color=#ff0000]Player Forward[/color][/b]
Ignores the mouse cursor completely and determines targets purely based on the direction your farmer is currently facing. Designed specifically for keyboard-only or controller players—or anyone who prefers a classic console-style experience without having to aim with a mouse. Highly recommended for controller users.
[img width=327]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55292/55292-1795524733-1699801082.gif[/img][/spoiler]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55292/55292-1795527830-1695515892.png[/img][/center]
[list]
Avoid other auto-tool selection mods: If you already have another mod installed with similar functionality to ToolSense, I strongly recommend not using them together, as conflicts may occur.[/list][list]
Compatibility: Since ToolSense is still in its initial 1.1.x release, it may not be fully compatible with certain mods that alter toolbar behavior or tool selection mechanics. Compatibility will continue to improve in future updates.[/list][list]
Updates: ToolSense will be updated regularly with bug fixes, improvements, and new features. If your current version feels stable and works well for you, feel free to stick with it—however, updating to the latest version is always your best bet for the optimal experience.[/list][list]
Recommended Settings: Keeping the default GMCM (Generic Mod Config Menu) configuration is recommended for the intended gameplay experience. Unless you have a specific reason to tweak something, I suggest leaving the default settings as they are[/list][center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55292/55292-1795528006-1501497363.png[/img][/center]
[list=1]
[*][b][color=#ff7700]Install SMAPI[/color][/b] (version 4.0.0 or later) if you haven't already.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ff7700]Download ToolSense[/color][/b] and extract the downloaded ZIP file.[/*]
[*]Move the
[code]ToolSense-AutoTool[/code]folder into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][b]Optional:[/b]
[list]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] to configure ToolSense directly in-game.[/*]
[/list]That's it! [b][color=#ff7700]ToolSense[/color][/b] is ready to use.
[b]Note:[/b] Make sure the folder structure looks like this:
[code]Stardew Valley/
└── Mods/
    └── ToolSense-AutoTool/
        ├── assets/
        ├── i18n/
        ├── AutoTool.dll
        ├── config.json
        └── manifest.json[/code][center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55292/55292-1795527931-2068387630.png[/img][/center]
[b][color=#00ff00]ToolSense[/color][/b] is still a new mod, so there may be issues that I haven't encountered during development or testing.
If you encounter any bugs, unexpected behavior, or compatibility issues, I would really appreciate it if you could report them in the Nexus comments or the Bugs section.
When reporting an issue, providing the following information would be very helpful:
[list]
[*]A description of the issue and how to reproduce it.[/*]
[*]Your SMAPI log.[/*]
[*]A list of other mods that may be related to the issue.[/*]
[/list]Your reports and feedback are incredibly valuable. They help me identify problems, improve compatibility, and make [b][color=#00ff00]ToolSense[/color][/b] better for everyone.
